Fellowship overview

This NTNU position applies artificial intelligence to monitoring ship traffic. It is a salaried doctoral research role in a maritime setting, with selection based on the qualifications and research preparation specified in the official recruitment advert.

Research Areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Maritime systems
  • Ship traffic monitoring

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionSalaried PhD position
Stipend / salaryFrom NOK 580,000 gross/year

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsAI and maritime research; relevant master's qualification.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen

LocationNorway

About Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

NTNU offers doctoral research in technology, science and other disciplines. Advertised PhD positions combine research training with employment and specify the research task, qualifications and contract terms.
